14:20.race_name: Star Sports We Believe In Bookmaking Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Dual hurdles winner; 12lb penalty to contend with but still a leading contender
runners.name: Crackerjacque
runners.spotlight: Record is 3-6, the wins in a Sandown bumper (good form) and novice hurdles here (about 2m2f, good to soft) and at Sandown (2m, heavy; first-time tongue-tie) three weeks ago; has to contend with a 12lb penalty but this return to further is probably in his favour and he holds leading claims.

runners.comment: Long odds-on when he scrambled home last time but he's better than that; key player
runners.name: Gaelic Pride
runners.spotlight: Won the bumper on this card last year; runner-up behind good horses in his first two maidens and again ran well at Ascot where he didn't see out the longer 2m5f as well as the principals; down in trip and long odds-on when he scrambled home at Wincanton (1m7f, soft) last time; he's better than that latest form and is a key player under the penalty.

runners.breeder: F Aimez Mme L Aimez P Aimez
runners.comment: Would be a surprise winner based on his moderate form in a bumper and two hurdle races
runners.name: Le Flying Ferret
runners.spotlight: Would be a surprise winner based on his moderate form in a bumper and two hurdle races, most recently when beaten 39l in a C&D novice (soft; 400-1).

runners.comment: Pulled up on hurdles debut and beaten 50l last time; needs considerable improvement
runners.name: Lifetime In Milan
runners.spotlight: Won his final Irish point in spring 2024 (3m, good to yielding); set a stiff task when pulled up in a Class 2 Windsor novice (3m, soft) on his stable/hurdling debut in January but didn't fair much better when beaten 50l in Lingfield maiden (about 2m4f, heavy) 17 days ago; will do well to trouble the big two.

runners.comment: Promising second in bumper here before an underwhelming hurdles debut; still early days
runners.name: West Along
runners.spotlight: Third in the second of two Irish points last spring but he did well to snatch a share of the runner-up spot in a bumper here (good to soft) in December; this month's hurdling debut at Lingfield (2m) was underwhelming but maybe heavy ground was an excuse.

runners.comment: Tailed off in two novice hurdles (soft and heavy); unlikely
runners.name: Casts Georgie
runners.owner: Sue & Clive Cole & Ann & Tony Gale
runners.spotlight: Dam was a useful dual-purpose performer but this 5yo has been tailed off in two novice hurdles (soft and heavy); unlikely.

14:50.race_name: Star Sports National Spirit Hurdle (Grade 2) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Won a classy conditions hurdle (career-best form) last month; holds strong claims again
runners.name: Potters Charm
runners.spotlight: Smart novice (Grade 1 winner on soft) at up to 2m5f last season; early faller on reappearance in November before 8l third in Grade 2 Ascot Hurdle (2m3f, good to soft); outstayed when fourth in Grade 1 Long Walk at Ascot (3m, good to soft) the following month but got back on the scoresheet when taking a classy Windsor conditions hurdle (2m4f, soft; career-best form) last month; key player despite a half penalty for the Grade 1 win.

runners.breeder: S C E A Hamel Stud
runners.comment: Won this in 2022 but was tailed off (handicap) latest and best days might be behind him
runners.name: Botox Has
runners.spotlight: 2-2 here, including when gamely holding Brewin'upastorm in the 2022 edition of this race; also won Grade 2 Rendlesham at Haydock (about 3m, heavy) in February 2024 but hasn't matched that form subsequently and was tailed off in a Windsor handicap (3m, soft) last month.

runners.comment: Form figures of 121 in this race but he's a 13yo now and not so good these days
runners.name: Brewinupastorm
runners.spotlight: 13yo who has a fine record in this race, his three appearances yielding two wins (2021 and 2023) and a head second to Botox Has in 2022; also bagged a Fairyhouse Grade 2 (2m4f, soft to heavy) in the spring of 2024; not so good these days, however, and he was beaten 13l in a Taunton handicap (2m3f, good to soft) last month.

runners.comment: Won Warwick handicap last time; bit to find but he's in form and could go well
runners.name: Phantomofthepoints
runners.owner: Mrs Jo Tracey K Alexander P&S Bryceland
runners.spotlight: Very useful handicapper who picked up a third hurdle race when comfortably landing Warwick handicap (2m5f, heavy) a fortnight ago; something to find in this company but he's in form and the type to run above himself.

runners.comment: Better than ever this term; won mares' Listed race last time; commands plenty of respect
runners.name: Nurse Susan
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced and thriving, better than ever at the age of nine; took hurdles record to 6-11 when staying on strongly to win Listed event at Sandown (2m4f, good; handles soft) early last month; has a 4lb penalty for that but she's very well entered up at the Cheltenham festival next month and commands plenty of respect here.

runners.comment: Course winner off 2lb lower in October; tailed off latest but drops back down in grade
runners.name: Paso Doble
runners.spotlight: Won here (extended 2m3f, good to soft) off just 2lb lower on his October reappearance; creditable placings when claimer ridden in six-runner races on his next two starts but was tailed off in a better race than this at Kempton last time; drops back down in grade with a tongue-tie joining his usual cheekpieces and he can't be ruled out.

runners.comment: Hasn't got going this term and down the field when back over hurdles last time
runners.name: Il Va De Soi
runners.spotlight: Well held when third on seasonal/chase debut in November and, after two non-completions, reverted to hurdling when down the field at Ascot (about 3m, good to soft) under Megan Fox last week; drop back in trip might help but others appeal more.

runners.comment: Made all at Chepstow 13 months ago; pulled up latest but now goes h'capping with potential
runners.name: Livingit Du Large
runners.spotlight: Made all in junior hurdle at Chepstow (2m, heavy) 13 months ago and respectable third of five when back in action at Ffos Las (2m, soft) in November; 3-1 but pulled up in Leicester novice (about 2m4f; heavy) next time when his trainer blamed the tacky ground; makes his handicap debut following wind surgery and it is likely we haven't see the best of him.

runners.comment: Rampant 8yo who has won his last four starts; the five-timer looks a distinct possibility
runners.name: Bollin Thou
runners.spotlight: Rampant 8yo who has won his last four starts (2m3f to 3m2f), most recently when staying on well to defy a hike up the weights at Sandown (2m4f, heavy) three weeks ago; up a further 6lb but the five-timer looks a distinct possibility.

runners.comment: Placed in higher-grade race this season but two lesser runs followed; wants better ground
runners.name: Night Stalker
runners.spotlight: 0-7 over hurdles; ran well when third (albeit safely held) in higher-grade event at Kempton (2m5f, good) in November but two lesser efforts have followed and the ground here is likely to be slower than he prefers.

runners.comment: Chasing has not gone well this season but he reverts to hurdling on a good mark
runners.name: All Authorized
runners.spotlight: Chasing has not gone well this season (three attempts) but he's now 4lb lower than when winning over hurdles at Plumpton (3m1f, good) last spring and will be fine on the slower ground here; dangerous to ignore.

runners.comment: Well beaten when upped to 2m5f for handicap debut at Exeter on Friday
runners.name: Tobi Kanobee
runners.spotlight: Displayed significant promise in two slow-ground maidens at Wincanton (1m7f) last month but was well beaten when upped to 2m5f for handicap debut at Exeter on Friday.

runners.comment: Rewarded market support at Wincanton last month, his second handicap; can progress again
runners.name: Local Derby
runners.spotlight: Always behind on handicap debut in December but rewarded good market support at Wincanton (2m4f, heavy) last month, despite still looking green in closing stages; recent 4lb rise is not excessive and he can improve again.

runners.comment: Showed no significant promise in his qualifying races; handicap debut today
runners.name: Betgoodwin
runners.spotlight: Still very unexposed but didn't show any significant promise in three maiden/novice hurdles (2m4f-2m5f) and connections have a much more obvious chance with Local Derby.

runners.comment: Out of form over fences last season but made all over hurdles this month, after a layoff
runners.name: Tommy Dillion
runners.spotlight: Badly out of form over fences last season but made all in a five-runner hurdle race at Lingfield (2m, heavy) this month, after a layoff, and remains on a good mark after 3lb rise; unexposed over this sort of trip; big player if able to build on that recent performance.

runners.comment: Scored over C&D in October and recently doubled his tally at Lingfield; respected
runners.name: Atlantic Power
runners.spotlight: Scored over C&D (good to soft) on seasonal debut in October and doubled his tally at Lingfield (2m7f, heavy) this month; still has a lowly mark after recent 5lb rise and ought to make his presence felt.

runners.breeder: Herve Robert & Mrs Adeline De Vitton
runners.comment: Twice safely held since a break but might be perked up by new headgear today
runners.name: Goguenard
runners.spotlight: Three-time hurdle winner; safely held on both outings (cheekpieces refitted last time) since returning in November from a break but suited by slow ground and might be perked up by first-time blinkers; worth a glance in the betting.

runners.comment: Useful bumper performer who has made a good start to his hurdling career; handicap debut
runners.name: Sinchi Roca
runners.spotlight: Useful bumper performer who won a Wincanton maiden (1m7f, soft) on last month's hurdle debut and was not discredited when fourth at Sandown (2m, heavy) three weeks ago; should have some improvement to come in handicaps; leading contender.

runners.comment: Safely held on first two British starts but last month's Hereford third was much better
runners.name: Col du Pre
runners.spotlight: Ex-French 5yo; started off for Venetia Williams with two low-key runs towards end of last year but last month's third at Hereford (2m, soft) was much more encouraging and it won't be a surprise if he kicks on again here.

runners.comment: 2m4f winner on hurdle debut; well-held second last time; back in trip for handicap debut
runners.name: The Boss Bear
runners.spotlight: Won good-ground bumper here last spring and returned from break to win five-runner maiden hurdle at Plumpton (2m4f, good to soft) in December; perhaps a shade disappointing when well-held second at Fakenham (2m4f, soft) nine days ago but remains very lightly raced; back in trip for handicap debut.

runners.breeder: E A R L Haras Du Camp Benard
runners.comment: Placed off reduced mark last month; back in trip with new headgear tried here
runners.name: Royal Way
runners.spotlight: Useful juvenile in 2023-24 season; became rather disappointing last term but kept on for third of 15 of reduced mark at Huntingdon (2m4f, soft) last month and has possibilities if combination of drop back in trip and first-time cheekpieces has a positive effect.

runners.comment: C&D winner last season and penultimate run hinted at a possible return to form
runners.name: Galactic Charm
runners.spotlight: Won over C&D (soft) last season and hinted at a possible return to form when keeping-on fourth at Huntingdon (2m, good to soft) in December; never seriously competitive at Lingfield (2m3f, soft) last month but sports refitted cheekpieces here and has slipped to a good mark.

runners.comment: Won on stable debut in December and has the services of Sean Bowen here
runners.name: Queenie St Clair
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish mare who made a winning stable debut in Wincanton handicap (1m7f, good to soft) on Boxing Day and was a respectable third in heavy-ground novice at Taunton (2m) this month; could still have more to offer for her new trainer and Sean Bowen is booked.

16:50.race_name: starsportsbet.co.uk Open Maiden National Hunt Flat Race (Category 3 Elimination) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Made good start to rules career when second of 12 at Warwick in December; obvious player
runners.name: Cheap Sandwiches
runners.spotlight: Changed hands after promising Irish point debut last March (yielding to soft) and made good start to rules career when second of 12 at Warwick (good to soft) in December; obvious contender.

runners.comment: Impressed on Irish point debut in 2024; £400,000 buy but did not race for Nicky Henderson
runners.name: Minella Premier
runners.spotlight: Joined Nicky Henderson for £400,000 after impressive Irish point debut in spring 2024 but did not race for him and is now in the care of Richard Hobson for belated rules debut; tongue-tie fitted; market may guide.

runners.comment: Cost £240,000 after winning Irish point on debut; new stable has excellent bumper record
runners.name: Red Acres Max
runners.spotlight: Held on for narrow win on Irish point debut in November (yielding to soft) and was bought for £240,000 soon afterwards; that form was nicely boosted when the clear runner-up won a recent Punchestown bumper for Gordon Elliott, and this fellow has joined a stable with an excellent bumper strike-rate (25%).

runners.comment: Placed in a point bumper in December but soundly beaten on recent rules debut
runners.name: Testing Patience
runners.spotlight: Placed in good-ground point bumper on debut in December but soundly beaten when 40-1 for rules debut at Kempton (good to soft) three weeks ago.

14:10.race_name: Congratulations Farmer Sams Walk Of Hope EBF Junior "National Hunt" Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Taunton win on second start before good Newbury second last time; first run on this ground
runners.name: Apollon Forlonge
runners.spotlight: Three sound runs so far, winning on good ground at Taunton on second start (2m) before decent second at Newbury last time (2m, good to soft); first run on testing ground; no easy task giving weight away all round.

runners.comment: Quite interesting on hurdles debut having finished runner-up in a Catterick bumper
runners.name: Campfield Flyer
runners.spotlight: Goes hurdling after creditable second in a Catterick bumper last time (1m7f, soft); quite interesting.

runners.comment: Second foal of an unraced half-sister to Group 3 winner; not obvious one on hurdles debut
runners.name: Captain Nigel
runners.spotlight: Second foal of an unraced half-sister to a 6f/7f Group 3 winner; not an obvious one on hurdles debut.

runners.comment: Favourite when second to Apollon Forlonge (who is 7lb worse off) on jumps debut; chance
runners.name: No Boundaries
runners.spotlight: Started 13-8 favourite when 7.5l runner-up to Apollon Forlonge (who is 7lb worse off here) on hurdles debut having finished fourth in a bumper on debut; could reverse the placings on these revised terms; first run on soft ground.

runners.comment: Half-brother to smart jumper/Flat stayer The Shunter, and is an interesting newcomer
runners.name: The Punter
runners.spotlight: 40,000euros foal by Affinisea; half-brother to smart 2m-2m5f chaser/hurdler The Shunter, who was also a smart stayer on the Flat; interesting newcomer.

runners.comment: £1,000 yearling by Bobby's Kitten; has a Flat pedigree and others appeal more
runners.name: Cantcallmethattrev
runners.spotlight: £1,000 yearling by Bobby's Kitten; half-sister to three Flat winners at up to 7f; others appeal more.

runners.comment: Ex-Irish; creditable fifth at Leopardstown on debut; should go well on stable debut
runners.name: Queen Maeve
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish; by Walk In The Park with a good jumps pedigree; shaped with a degree of promise when 11.5l fifth to an interesting prospect in an academy hurdle at Leopardstown on her debut; should go well on stable debut.

14:40.race_name: DragonBet The Roar Before Is Coming Mares' Maiden Hurdle (Herring Queen Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Ex-Irish bumper winner; cost £70,000 in November; down in trip after low-key jumps debut
runners.name: Ballymoreen
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish; beat a 1-3 Mullins favourite when winning a Wexford bumper in October (2m, yiedling); bought for £70,000 in November; low-key hurdles debut when 25l sixth of 16 at Taunton (2m3f, good to soft); may do better down in trip.

runners.comment: Some promise in two British point bumpers but marked improvement needed on hurdles debut
runners.name: Crystal Box
runners.spotlight: Some promise in two British point bumpers before Christmas (2m, soft/good) but marked improvement needed on her hurdles/stable debut.

runners.comment: Placed in two Sedgefield bumpers; well beaten when 80-1 on hurdles debut; more needed
runners.name: Drakaris
runners.spotlight: Placed in two Sedgefield bumpers in November/December (first on soft ground); never-dangerous seventh of 11 in a Ludlow novice on hurdles debut (2m, soft; 80-1); more needed.

runners.breeder: Phillip C And Mrs Kathryn M Dando
runners.comment: Newcomer by Jack Hobbs; half-sister to 2m4f/2m5f hurdle winner; dam bumper/hurdles winner
runners.name: Honey Haze
runners.spotlight: Mare by Jack Hobbs who is a half-sister to a 2m4f/2m5f hurdles winner; dam a bumper/hurdles winner; makes debut.

runners.comment: Interesting hurdles newcomer who has won a point bumper, a point and been 2nd in a bumper
runners.name: Just A Glance
runners.spotlight: Won a point bumper and a British maiden point (2m4f) before finishing runner-up in an Aintree bumper in May (all on good ground); goes hurdling having had wind surgery; interesting newcomer.

runners.comment: Place in two bumpers; fair sixth in a Taunton mares' maiden hurdle last time; interesting
runners.name: Lyrical Choice
runners.spotlight: Placed in two bumpers; fair form in runs over hurdles, last time finishing 10.5l fifth of 13 in a Taunton mares' maiden (2m, good to soft; form working out quite well); interesting.

runners.comment: Bumper winner who has finished second on both hurdle starts and should go well again
runners.name: Madame La Papillon
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner for Laura Morgan in 2024 (2m, soft); runner-up on both runs over hurdles, last time finishing a long way clear of the remainder at Newcastle (2m, good to soft); should go well again.

runners.comment: Well-beaten 16-1 shot in a Doncaster bumper in January last year; should do better
runners.name: Miss Macaroni
runners.spotlight: Mare by Blue Bresil out of a French 1m2f winner; well-beaten 16-1 shot in a Doncaster bumper in January 2025 (2m, good to soft); stable having a fine season; should do better.

runners.comment: Quite a useful staying handicapper on the Flat for William Haggas; interesting newcomer
runners.name: Molten Sea
runners.spotlight: Quite a useful handicapper at up to 2m for William Haggas on the Flat; bought for 20,000gns last October; acts on soft ground; an interesting newcomer.

runners.comment: Second in an Irish point in 2024 but hasn't shown a great deal under rules for new yard
runners.name: Shanagolden Girl
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in an Irish point in November 2024; not shown a great deal in a bumper or in two races over hurdles; others stronger.

runners.comment: Irish point second who has shown ordinary form under rules for present yard; best watched
runners.name: Shes All Pride
runners.spotlight: Second in an Irish point in November 2024; not shown much in a bumper and two races over hurdles; others preferred this time.

runners.comment: Placed in three bumpers in 2022; has since had two wind ops; back after 836-day absence
runners.name: Tipperary Star
runners.spotlight: Placed in three bumpers on soft/heavy in 2022; well beaten both starts since, the latest on hurdles debut at Newbury in November 2023 when making one bad mistake; has had two wind operations, latest in October 2025; back after 836-day absence.

runners.comment: Dual Flat winner who has finished in the frame all 3 starts over hurdles; each-way chance
runners.name: Penn Avenue
runners.spotlight: Dual Flat winner at up to 1m4f for the Kublers (best RPR 67); in the frame on all three starts over hurdles, last time finishing runner-up in a mares' handicap at Plumpton; each-way chance.

15:10.race_name: DragonBet The Roar Before Cheltenham Awaits Veterans' Handicap Chase

runners.comment: Off the mark for the season at Market Rasen last time; up 3lb; should go well
runners.name: Immortal Fame
runners.spotlight: Three wins last term; got off the mark for the season when winning by a head at Market Rasen last time (3m, soft; first two clear); up 3lb; chance.

runners.comment: Fair efforts in good-ground chases in the summer; debut for new yard; going not ideal
runners.name: Tiger Orchid
runners.spotlight: Formerly with Richard Newland and Jamie Insole; mainly fair efforts for them in good-ground chases in the summer; makes stable debut on return from break; has won on soft but ideally needs better ground.

runners.comment: Formerly a very useful chaser; not the force of old but good 4th in October; new headgear
runners.name: Pats Fancy
runners.spotlight: Very useful chaser at his peak (last win was in 2021); not the force he was, but handicapped accordingly; fair fourth at Ffos Las in October (3m1f, soft; cheekpieces on for first time); not so good since (pulled up in Welsh National last time); blinkers now tried.

runners.comment: 1-5 over fences; fair third at Catterick last month; conditions suit; may do better
runners.name: My Bobby Dazzler
runners.spotlight: Having only his sixth run over fences; fair third at Catterick (3m1f, good to soft) last time on only second chase start since December 2023; conditions suit; may do better.

runners.comment: Last win was in November 2023 but worth considering after good 2nd at Chepstow last time
runners.name: Not Sure
runners.spotlight: No win since November 2023, but conditions suit and he comes into the reckoning following his good second at Chepstow nine days ago (2m7f, soft).

runners.comment: Formerly a smart hurdler/chaser; has declined markedly and best watched at present
runners.name: The Jam Man
runners.spotlight: One-time smart hurdler/chaser but very much on the decline these days and is best watched after some ordinary efforts this season.

runners.comment: C&D winner; good second in mares' handicap last time; stable going well now; chance
runners.name: Flowing Cadenza
runners.spotlight: C&D winner whose last win came at Ffos Las in January 2023; lightly raced since, one of her best runs when second in a mares' handicap at Huntingdon last time (2m7f, soft); stable in better form now; good chance.

15:40.race_name: DragonBet Cheltenham Infernoboosts Back For Roar Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Beaten 67l when fifth of eight at Taunton on racecourse debut 19 days ago.
runners.name: Angel Wave
runners.spotlight: Beaten 67l when fifth of eight at Taunton (2m3f, heavy; 11-2) on racecourse debut 19 days ago; in good hands though and no surprise were he to show significant improvement with that run under his belt.

runners.comment: Made a pleasing start to his hurdling career when runner-up here last month.
runners.name: Glancing Jack
runners.spotlight: Won bumper here (2m, good to soft) on debut in December 2024; made a pleasing start to his hurdling career when runner-up here (2m, good to soft) last month; should be suited by this step up in trip and must be on the shortlist.

runners.comment: Has failed to complete on both starts over hurdles for current trainer.
runners.name: Kingdom Of Stars
runners.spotlight: Won on the Flat for Tom Ward in July; sold for 32,000gns in October; has failed to complete on both starts over hurdles for current trainer; first-time hood goes on and he needs to do better.

runners.comment: Sixth of ten finishers on racecourse debut in bumper at Exeter last month.
runners.name: Malinaero
runners.spotlight: Sixth of ten finishers on racecourse debut in bumper at Exeter (2m, good to soft; 28-1) last month; makes hurdles debut and looks to be one for the future.

runners.comment: Ran okay in two bumpers last season but well held in two runs over hurdles.
runners.name: Parliamo
runners.spotlight: Ran okay in two bumpers last season but was tailed off when 150-1 for hurdle debut at Chepstow (2m3f, good to soft) in November; had wind surgery subsequently but was then beaten 48l in a Ludlow maiden (2m5f, good to soft) last month and doesn't look the answer here.

runners.comment: Showed improved form when beaten half a length in a Ffos Las maiden last month.
runners.name: Tommy Pickles
runners.spotlight: Maiden Irish point winner who made a pleasing start over hurdles when third of seven finishers at Newton Abbot (2m5f, good to soft) in October; had wind surgery subsequently and showed improved form when beaten half a length in a Ffos Las maiden (2m4f, heavy) last month; looked a winner in waiting that day and should be hard to beat.

runners.comment: Made a pleasing start under rules when fourth in a Ludlow maiden 18 days ago.
runners.name: Jurassic Pet
runners.spotlight: Bought for £28,000 after winning an Irish point by 8l last spring (on yielding); made a pleasing start under rules when fourth of nine finishers in a Ludlow maiden (2m5f, soft) 18 days ago; should run well but we may not see the best of her until she goes chasing.

16:10.race_name: Claim Your DragonBet Welcome Offer Novices' Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Hasn't set the world alight in four goes over hurdles this term but back in calmer waters.
runners.name: Walk Tall
runners.spotlight: Irish point winner who looked a nice prospect when runner-up in a bumper at Exeter last February but hasn't set the world alight in four goes over hurdles this term, admittedly at top tracks; maybe this switch to calmer waters can set him back on track.

runners.comment: Hasn't taken to chasing this term and switches back to hurdles.
runners.name: Devon Dude
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner who looked a promising hurdler last season when runner-up three times; hasn't taken to chasing this term and now switches back to hurdles; Harry Cobden looks to be a notable booking.

runners.comment: Won over C&D in November; down the field at Newbury last month but worth another chance.
runners.name: On The Go
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark when scoring over C&D (good) in November off 10lb lower mark; never threatened when tenth of 14 finishers at Newbury (3m, good to soft) last month but may be worth another chance back here.

runners.comment: Ran his best race for current yard when third of nine finishers at Ludlow 18 days ago.
runners.name: Lion Of The Desert
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish maiden; ran his best race for current yard when third of nine finishers at Ludlow (2m5f, soft) 18 days ago; going the right way and has place prospects once again.

runners.comment: Has shown ability in all three starts, latest when third of 11 finishers here 11 days ago.
runners.name: Garavogue
runners.spotlight: Has shown ability in all three starts, latest when third of 11 finishers here (2m, heavy) 11 days ago; steps up in trip on handicap debut and one to be interested in, especially if the market speaks favourably.

runners.comment: Well beaten over hurdles on all three starts but it's still early days; up in trip
runners.name: Cote dAnge
runners.spotlight: Well beaten over hurdles on all three starts but it's still early days and he steps up in trip on handicap debut; no forlorn hope.

runners.comment: Has shown little in her four starts, latest when tailed off at Warwick last month.
runners.name: Lily Grace
runners.spotlight: Has shown little in her four starts, latest when tailed off at Warwick (2m3f, good to soft) last month on her first start for 1,001 days; may do better now she goes handicapping but big improvement required.

16:40.race_name: DragonBet Supports Safer Gambling Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Not the force of old but won in first-time cheekpieces at Catterick this month; respected
runners.name: Imperial Bede
runners.spotlight: Evidently not the force of old but built upon an encouraging reappearance when winning in first-time cheekpieces at Catterick (2m3f, soft) a fortnight ago and has good claims here if the headgear continues to aid him.

runners.comment: Won this in 2025 and is back on a good mark but has become very unreliable
runners.name: Zestful Hope
runners.spotlight: Won this in 2025 (good to soft) and was also on target at Huntingdon (2m4f, good) in October; back on a good mark now and should be fine on today's forecast soft ground but has become far too inconsistent to rely upon.

runners.comment: Looked laboured here last month but she's on good mark if back on song in new cheekpieces
runners.name: Passing Kate
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late David M Richards
runners.spotlight: Won two soft-ground chases (both 2m3f) in early 2025 and has posted some good efforts in defeat this season; looked laboured and was below form here (2m, soft) last month but can be dangerous off current mark if back on song in first-time cheekpieces.

runners.name: Zacony Rebel
